confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on aggregated Lucerne and Swiss figures from web searches. Figures are crowdsourced and mixed in year and currency, so they are approximate. Beer and wine are based on Swiss draught and restaurant price ranges. Cocktail is estimated from the local beer relationship because direct data was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, with no accommodation search or live listings checked. The FX rate is from a secondary aggregator reporting an RBA 4pm figure, not a direct rba.gov.au table read, and CHF-to-USD conversion is assumed at about 1.25.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lucerne is treated as a high-cost Swiss tourist city. Restaurant anchors follow Swiss national and Lucerne-specific aggregated ranges, with Lucerne at roughly 18% above the Swiss average for restaurants. Accommodation follows general Swiss lakeside tourist-city levels, comparable to Zurich and Basel.
